case.title: Import example — shared announcement
case.question: Do identical posts establish that one operator controls the accounts?

coverage.description: Two fictional records illustrating the import format.

limitations: This is an editable synthetic template, not a real investigation.
Original timestamps, source URLs and account ownership are unknown.

records.text: The fictional Harbor Bulletin reports that three accounts shared the same announcement at 09:00. The announcement was also available in a public press kit.
The fictional event organizer invited supporters to copy its public announcement. This record does not identify who operates the three accounts.
